_comment: Runnable (system-1) conformance spec for bundle-events, projected from .claude/contracts/bundle-events/INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md '## Conformance spec' into the flat schema interface_conformance.py executes ({method,path,path_params,query,required}). Standalone convention (mirrors iv_rank.json / ai_context_pack.json / dealer-flow-projection.json), NOT folded into another feature's spec — the owner's 2026-06-23 system-12 decision. The feature's ONLY wire delta is the additive nested field market_state.event_calendar: the KEY is ALWAYS emitted on a post-feature backend, but its VALUE is legitimately NULLABLE (a missing/corrupt/unreadable events.json => null with the bundle still 200, [best-effort-isolated-or-null]). So the key is asserted as object|null and NO child path is asserted as required — asserting `state` unconditionally would FAIL a legitimately-null best-effort cycle, which is the degradation the interface guarantees. The `?` suffixes below make the children OPTIONAL-but-typed: absent (null block) passes, present must match — which pins the block's SHAPE (the closed `state` token as a string, the bounded upcoming `events[]` array with its 7 pinned per-event fields, and the four self-describing calendar_* fields) without pinning a populated payload. NOTE what this spec deliberately CANNOT prove: that `unknown` and `none` are not collapsed (INTERFACE §2 — the load-bearing claim, since both states carry events: [] and only `state` disambiguates), and that an expired calendar forces `unknown`. Those are semantic, per-ticker facts; they are verified off-harness by src/scanner/events_projection_selftest.py (with an independent mutant RED of the collapse) plus the live three-state read GATE Q runs (a curated-with-dates ticker => scheduled, an ETF => none, one of the deliberately-uncurated TSLA/MU/CSCO/UNH => unknown). The rest is the REGRESSION FLOOR the [additive-keeps-score-byte-identical] invariant demands: the additive field must not perturb score/tier/gate/fingerprint and market_state must stay the same envelope shape. RESUME gotcha: the /api/ticker COLD path can exceed the tool's 30s timeout -> WARM the URL first within the 60s cache TTL (curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/ticker/SPY?min_dte=7&max_dte=45') then run; OR validate offline with --spec ... --sample <bundle.json> --endpoint "/api/ticker/{ticker}". Uses SPY (a liquid ticker, and a curated `none` ETF; fetch once before running). EXTENDED by feature `expiration-events` (2026-07-27, per its INTERFACE §1 + BACKEND_EXECUTION_CONTRACT §1.3 — extended here, NOT given a second spec file): the same block gained `expirations[]`, one summary row per tenor of the bundle's own full-chain term-structure curve flagging whether a scheduled event falls inside that option's life. It is pinned with the same optional-but-typed discipline, for the same reason — the array is legitimately EMPTY for `state: unknown`, for `state: none`, and for a bundle with no usable tenor curve, so presence of a populated list can never be required. What the harness CANNOT prove for it either: the containment rule (an `amc` event dated ON the expiry is NOT contained; a `session: null` one IS), and that `state` still governs an empty list. Both are semantic and are verified off-harness by the mutation-tested selftest + the live boundary read on NVDA.

endpoints._comment: SPY is a curated `none` ticker, so its expirations[] is legitimately EMPTY and the element-level types above pass vacuously. This case re-reads the same shape on NVDA — curated WITH a future earnings date — so the per-tenor element types are actually exercised on a populated array. Still `?`-optional for the same reason as everything else here: a missing/corrupt events.json must degrade to null + 200, not fail conformance. What this case CANNOT prove is the containment rule itself (which tenors are flagged) — that is semantic and is verified off-harness by src/scanner/events_projection_selftest.py (incl. the mutant RED of both edge cases) plus the live boundary read.
